related.title: Quantum ESPRESSO：平面波截止與可觀測量收斂成本
related.titleEn: Quantum ESPRESSO: plane-wave cutoff and observable-convergence cost
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只有指定可觀測量通過獨立敏感度檢查，才放行後續計算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Release downstream calculations only after the specified observable passes its independent tolerance-sensitivity check.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「Quantum ESPRESSO：平面波截止與可觀測量收斂成本」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付截止掃描表、預估與實際基底欄位、能量差及目標量驗收報告。
related.differenceEn: Investigate Quantum ESPRESSO: plane-wave cutoff and observable-convergence cost using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver a cutoff sweep with separate estimated and actual basis-count columns, observable differences and an acceptance report that records pseudopotential, cell and sampling choices.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 逐項乘 0.2，計算 e6 並與 1e−5 比較；以相鄰缺陷之比重新估計 q，交由另一人核算。
從動能正比於波向量平方開始，得到半徑正比截止平方根，再以三維球體積推導基底數比例。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Multiply successively by 0.2, calculate the sixth defect and compare it with 1e-5. Independently estimate q from adjacent history entries and ask a second investigator to check the iteration numbering and threshold comparison.

Start from kinetic energy proportional to squared wavevector magnitude, obtain a reciprocal-space radius proportional to the square root of cutoff, then use three-dimensional sphere volume to derive the count ratio without assuming integer equality.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: NEMO：濕格體積、部分網格與海洋平均
related.titleEn: NEMO: wet-cell volume, partial cells and ocean means
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只有指定可觀測量通過獨立敏感度檢查，才放行後續計算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Release downstream calculations only after the specified observable passes its independent tolerance-sensitivity check.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「NEMO：濕格體積、部分網格與海洋平均」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付濕體積帳本、遮罩真值表、兩種平均與零分母驗收案例。
related.differenceEn: Investigate NEMO: wet-cell volume, partial cells and ocean means using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver wet-volume ledgers, a mask truth table, both weighted means and zero-denominator acceptance cases, documenting whether the reported quantity is a volume mean or a heat-content diagnostic.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 逐項乘 0.2，計算 e6 並與 1e−5 比較；以相鄰缺陷之比重新估計 q，交由另一人核算。
計算 10+60 的分子與四的分母；和兩點簡單平均十五比較，指出多數水體位於較暖格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Multiply successively by 0.2, calculate the sixth defect and compare it with 1e-5. Independently estimate q from adjacent history entries and ask a second investigator to check the iteration numbering and threshold comparison.

Calculate numerator 10+60 and denominator four. Compare the result with the unweighted two-point mean of fifteen and explain why the larger warm cell must contribute more to the volume-weighted statistic.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
